page.layout: One page of text. At the top, two medallion engravings side by side, each with its legend around the rim: left "MAHOMETES" (right side) and "IVTVRC. IMP." (left side); right "BAIAZETES" (right side) and "TVRC. IMP." (left side). Below them, two paragraphs of running text in one column, with no margin notes. Page number top left; running head top centre.

main_text.l: IVTVRC. IMP. [?]
MAHOMETES
MAHOMETES, hoc nomine secundus, Turcarũ verò
Rex octauus, Amurathi, etiam huius nominis secūdo, succedit
anno mundi 5411. à Christo nato 1449. Hic regnum à parri-
cidio auspicatur. fratrem paruulum, ne pater solus sepeliretur,
opera Mosis interficit. Impiissimus nullum Deum credidit: Ma-
hometem suum, Pseudoprophetam sui similem dixit: Prophe-
tas ac Patriarchas risit, ac nugas duxit: huic tametsi impio, fauit
aliquando fortuna. Nam magni cognomentum Othomannicæ
familiæ quæsiuit. Duo Christianorum imperia Constantinopo-
litanum & Trapezuntinum subuertit: regna 12. ademit: ducen-
tas urbes Christianas cepit: Ipse colico dolore correptus, quar-
to demum die moritur, anno ætatis 58. regni 31. Richer. lib. 4.
Paul. Iou. Egna. lib. 2. Cosm. Munst. lib. 4.
BAIAZETES hoc nomine secundus, Mahometis supra-
dicti filius Ianizarorū opera Turcis imperat anno mundi 5442.
à Christo nato 1480. Hic minorem fratrem Zizimum, quem
primores Imperatorem exposcebat, vincit ac fugat: qui à Rho-
di praefecto ad Carolum octauum in Galliam mittitur. Porrò
Baiazetes Caramanno fuso, quaecunque is cis & trans Taurum
Turcis ademerat, recepit: Valachiam subegit: In Sultanum Æ-
gyptium mouit: Sed is potentior, vtpote qui Mamaluchos, post
Caramanni cædem fugitiuos exceperat, ac Arabum maximas
copias ad sui tuitionem alebat, Baiazete sæpe debilitat, ac pro-
fligat: postea Cerauniorum montium accolas subdit. Venetis
Methonem, nunc Modonem, Nepathum, olim Naupactum,
& Dyrrachium ademit. Acomathem primogenitum decrepitus
Baiazetes absentem in locū suum substituit: Sed, Ianizaris Zeli-
mo suffragantibus, cogitur pater Zelimum pro Acomathe sub-
stituere. paulò post imperio deturbatus à filio Zelimo, ab eodē
filio veneno necatur, anno regni 30. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Medallion legends are read from the engravings; "IVTVRC. IMP." is uncertain, and the right legend may read "TVRC. IMP.". "eodē" at a line end: the macron over the e is faint, so it is uncertain. The numbers 1 and 4 in "Richer. lib. 4." and "regni 31." are slightly blurred. A faint show-through line lies between the two paragraphs and is not transcribed. The small-capital openings MAHOMETES and BAIAZETES are kept as printed.
